brief: Quayside Staffing is an offshore staffing company in Cebu, Philippines. We hire dedicated customer support agents, bookkeepers and virtual assistants for small ecommerce and property management businesses in Australia and New Zealand. Founded in 2016. 140 staff in one Cebu office. Clients approve every hire after an interview. Each client gets one account manager and a monthly report. No call recordings. Clients: Tidewater Homewares, Kauri Property Group, Saltbush Outdoor, Harbourline Rentals, Bramble Kitchenware, Northcove Realty. Reviews: 'Quayside found us two support agents in three weeks and both are still with us.' Priya Nair, Operations Manager, Tidewater Homewares, 5 stars. 'Our bookkeeper in Cebu closes the month before our own team is back from the weekend.' Tom Walsh, Director, Kauri Property Group, 5 stars. 'Clear invoices, one contact person and staff who ask good questions.' Ana Ruiz, Founder, Saltbush Outdoor, 4 stars. Office: Unit 1204, Skyrise Tower, Salinas Drive, Cebu City. Email hello@quayside.example.
